content:
Maria Chen: FYI I pushed a new hit-rate drill into the analytics workspace — focused on seed-key sparsity and tokens saved per-request. link: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/cache/seed-sparsity :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex Park: Nice. Do we have the curve by sequence-length bucket? that was the missing piece last time
Maria Chen: Yup, top-left is seq len buckets (<=64, 65-256, 256+) and you can toggle model family. Defaults to rolling 24h
Samir Patel: Seeing a weird dip for model=redwood-3-small in the 65-256 bucket starting ~4078870000. Was that when we flipped the new kernel selection?
Alex Park: That lines up with the kernel rollout window. @Kei can you check whether batching heuristics changed concurrently?
Kei Watanabe: Checking logs now. The scheduler rolled a faster batch-sizing heuristic at 4078869000 to reduce latency. I have a quick query:
Kei Watanabe: ```sql
select time, hit_rate, tokens_saved from cache_metrics
where model='redwood-3-small' and seq_bucket='65-256'
order by time desc limit 200;
```
Kei Watanabe: Initial look: hit_rate dropped ~6% and tokens_saved down ~12%. Kernel selector also switched to the kernel variant that optimizes for long context memory copies — may increase per-request cold path and break some key canonicalization heuristics
Samir Patel: Interesting — could be a KV cache key normalization mismatch when kernel changes reorder tokenization or fingerprinting steps
Maria Chen: Can we validate by replaying a small traffic slice against old kernel locally? I can spin up the profiler for the same tenant slice (tenant=acme-corp)
Alex Park: Good idea. If replay reproduces the hit-rate delta, we should add a short-lived feature-flag to force old kernel for that tenant while we patch keying
Kei Watanabe: I'll prepare a diff that forces the previous kernel selector for the experiment. Perf run command for repro: `./replay_tool --tenant acme-corp --model redwood-3-small --start 4078868000 --end 4078872000 --collect cache-keys`
OpsBot: deploy: batch-selector-rollout reverted for canary group (acme-corp) by Kei Watanabe at 4078901200
Samir Patel: After revert, dashboard shows hit_rate climbing back. Can we add an automated alert rule when tokens_saved delta > 8% vs baseline for any tenant+route combo?
Maria Chen: Yes — I'll add an alert in the seed-key panel and create a lightweight runbook: steps = [replay slice, force old kernel, collect key diffs, open PR].
Alex Park: Also add an annotation to the dashboard when kernel selector changes so ops can correlate future drops quickly
Maria Chen: Action items: 1) Kei to open PR with kernel-selector feature-flag and repro script (ETA today). 2) Samir to implement a key-diff collector to compare canonicalized keys across kernels. 3) Maria to add alert + dashboard annotation and runbook.
Samir Patel: I'll start the key-diff collector and push an initial prototype by EOD. Will post perf samples here. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Thanks team. Keeping the dashboard link pinned in the channel for updates.
